## Quality gates
- [ ] Pint
- [ ] PHPStan max
- [ ] Pest (all green, including new tests)
- [ ] tsc --noEmit
- [ ] ESLint --max-warnings=0
- [ ] Prettier --check
- [ ] Vitest
- [ ] mypy --strict (if Python touched)
- [ ] Manually tested in Chrome and Firefox
- [ ] Mobile viewport (375 px) sanity-checked
